Two days ago (the 10th), the Home Affairs Department announced the "Woh Tsai Shan Enhancement Plan," which will phase out the long-standing illegal structures on Bishop's Hill in Sham Shui Po. The first phase covers the area from the foot to the summit of the hillside sitting-out area at Tong Yam Street, while the second phase covers the enclosed area from the foot to the summit of the hill near Berwick Street.

At present, the second phase area still retains many fitness equipment and deity statues, and residents can be seen on-site playing shuttlecock, table tennis, and using the fitness equipment. As for the area around the Tong Yam Street hillside sitting-out area, barbed wire and hoarding boards were already erected last night, with security guards stationed this morning to prohibit residents from entering.
